geological_mapping.description: The dominant, massive high-albedo calcium carbonate layer forming the central bluffs of the coastal shelf.
Laminated, darker clay-rich marine mud bands running horizontally through the middle of the exposure.
Distinctive nodular lenses and bands of glassy, dark silica embedded securely within the lower chalk benches.

background_environment.lighting: High-key direct sunlight with soft-edged cinematic shadows, casting subtle ambient occlusion between the blocks to emphasize their 3D volume without blowing out the high-albedo white surfaces.
